meta.title: Train from Da Nang to Hue|Which side of the train should you get? (+Visiting Hue Imperial City)
meta.description:
Come along with me as I take one of the most scenic train rides in the world! In this video, I’m traveling from Da Nang to Hue aboard the train via the famous Hai Van Pass, where the mountains meet the ocean with incredible coastal views. 

Once we arrive in Hue, we head straight to explore the historic Imperial City (Hue Citadel), diving into the rich culture, grand architecture, and royalty history of Vietnam. If you're planning a trip to Central Vietnam or just love travel vlogs, I hope this video gives you a good look at what the experience is like! 

Don't forget to hit like, leave a comment, and subscribe for more travel adventures!

#danang #heritagetrain #huevietnam #imperialcity #hue
